pr.title: Catalogue IRIS HIV/immunization/vaccine items by reference: run.ts subset + pilot
pr.body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"litlfred"} -->
_Requested by **litlfred** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9?thread=cmsg_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9URtoXkkMHFsrXX8CVbmjs6)_

Closes #207 (Stage 0 + pilot). Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/KbuShxMsb8qDZBQ8MJQ7dA

## What

- **`bun scripts/iris-cdn/run.ts subset`**: catalogues part of IRIS with no bytes fetched. For each item it writes:
  - `catalogue/records/<handle>.dc.json`, the DSpace record via core's `dspaceToRecord`, with every field, repeat and language tag kept.
  - `catalogue/nodes/item-<handle>.json`, in state `referenced`. Its ORIGINAL bitstreams link to `https://iris.who.int/bitstreams/{uuid}/download`. IRIS's MD5 goes in the note; no sha256 is claimed (R13). Parents are `[]` (R10), and the note names the owning collection.
  - Inputs: a handles file first, then a Discovery query (`--sample n --seed s`, `--limit n`, or all).
  - `IRIS_DSPACE_TOKEN`, if set, is sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`.
  - Nodes it did not write are skipped and reported. A re-run with nothing new writes nothing: checked live, 44 unchanged and 0 written.
- **Folded into `run.ts`**, not a new file. That keeps the content-holds-code list in cat-harness-tools unchanged (the #197 precedent).
- **`scripts/iris-cdn/subsets/`** holds the owner's match query (Q-IRIS-1 = A: HIV, immuni\* or vaccin\* in title, subject, MeSH or abstract; 17,248 matches today) and the DAK citation list.
- The **skill `iris-rest-feed`** gains a section on subsets: field queries vs. full text, the lowercase `or` trap, and PID/ISBN/govdoc lookups.

## Pilot (run anonymously, Q-IRIS-3 = A)

- **57 IRIS items cited by the HIV and immunization DAKs.** These were collected from the DAKs' own text (the IRIS TEXT bundle of 10665/375230 and 10665/380303) and from the WHO and litlfred smart-hiv / smart-immunizations repos. 12 were already held by hand (left alone). 1 is **withdrawn on IRIS**: 10665/255705, *Measles vaccines: WHO position paper, April 2017*. 44 were written.
- **100 items sampled with seed 207** from the 17,248 matches.
- **144 new referenced nodes**, 211 nodes total. `dc:render` and the iris pages were regenerated.
- **7 citations did not resolve by identifier** and are listed in the subset file for a person to look up: two PAHO ISBNs, WHO-HIV-2017.17-1, a who.int slug, and 10665/92462.

## Checks run locally

`check:catalogue` ✓ · `dc:render:check` ✓ · `iris:pages:check` ✓ · `bun run test` 93/93 · `lint` ✓ · `check:command-paths` ✓ · `readme:sync:check` ✓

`iris-oxigraph.test.ts` → `searchFiltersDateRangeAndSpatial` asserted that the catalogue held exactly one Geneva item from the 1990s. It now checks the filter instead: every hit is in range, and the style manual is among them.

## Before Stage 2 (all 17,248)

- The home page's **Recent Submissions** lists every item. It grew by about 1,600 lines per locale for 144 items, so it needs a cap before the full set.
- Per Q-IRIS-2 = A, records stay in main. The full set is about 34k node+record files plus 2 DC renderings each in `site/dublin-core/`.

---
